data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG confirms an electricity supply contract (tariff "Ökostrom Fix 12") starting 1 January 2026 with a 12-month initial term. The monthly advance payment is €78.00.
data.explanation: This confirms your new electricity contract. Supply begins on 1 January 2026 and the initial term is 12 months. You pay a monthly advance payment (Abschlag) of €78.00. To end the contract, you must give one month's notice to the end of the initial term; otherwise it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The app calculates your cancellation deadline. The provider will handle the switch from your previous supplier.
